edges.child_node: "United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare"

Id1.text: Abraham A. Ribicoff was in office as the United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare at the same time as John F. Kennedy was president. Ribicoff was a US citizen and died in the United States after being married to Ruth Ribicoff during his life.

Id2.text: Abraham A. Ribicoff, an American, was in office while John F. Kennedy was president and worked for the United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare office. He was married to Ruth Ribicoff and later died in the United States.
